_doc: Dummy planet: its pollution kinds (same fields as a real pollution kinds table, see planets/verdance/data/pollution.json). 'dross' is the base kind. 'spores' is a kind no shipped planet has: it exists only in this file, to prove that a new kind needs data and no code. It is held waste on about half the land hexes from ring 3 out, cleared with the watering can once the flag test_spore_mask is set, or by watering robots, and each hex of it costs half a seed. mastery: this planet's own mastery numbers (4 levels, doubling), with the robot speed curve and the proximity bonus given here because the dummy planet has no robots table of its own.
